title: cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Maya Chen
description: Implements the first end-to-end autopilot for cost-optimization defaults: (1) runtime autotune that picks batching and prefix/KV caching defaults per model profile and workload shape, (2) standardized quantization profile templates exposed in the model registry and a flow for recommending a profile based on latency/cost/quality targets, and (3) unit-economics tooling exposed in the console and CLI to simulate per-request cost under different config choices. Motivation: teams spend too much time hand-tuning batch/caching/quant settings; this PR automates safe defaults and provides a tooling surface for cost/quality tradeoffs. Includes migration logic for existing Dedicated pools and a rollout plan with canary stages and opt-out flags.
